answer_1.quote: Our experiments focus on PostPKT and PrePKT in three benchmark categories: world knowledge, mathematical reasoning, and code generation, using Llama-2-based models.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for question answering (MMLU), step-by-step reasoning for mathematical problems (GSM8K), and code snippets for programming tasks (HumanEval, MBPP).

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We calculate zero-shot accuracy for GSM8K and MMLU, pass@1 for HumanEval and MBPP.
